source: Where money sits and moves for adult work, and how each place tends to fail: closed accounts, frozen payouts, a platform holding a balance. Drawn from performers' own accounts of account closures; not a rating of any company.
confidenceNote: closeRisk is a starting point for the kind, not a fact about your bank. Set your own from what you have seen.
note: A balance still sitting on a platform, unpaid out, is the riskiest money you have: it is theirs until it lands. The Rails page counts it apart.

kinds.label: Bank account
kinds.hint: Checking or savings in your name, or the practice's.

kinds.label: Payment processor
kinds.hint: The company that turns card payments into a deposit for you.

kinds.label: Payment app
kinds.hint: A peer to peer app. Most forbid adult work in their terms, so a closure can come without warning.

kinds.label: Platform balance (not paid out yet)
kinds.hint: Money a site shows you but has not sent. Not yours until it lands.

kinds.label: Cash
kinds.hint: Notes in a safe place. Cannot be frozen; can be lost, stolen or questioned.

kinds.label: Crypto
kinds.hint: A wallet you hold the keys to. Cannot be closed; can lose value fast and is hard to spend.

kinds.label: Prepaid or gift cards
kinds.hint: Gift cards and prepaid balances taken as tribute.

rules.oneRailNote: When most of your income lands through one rail, a closure there is a closure of the practice.

checklist.label: Two banks, not one
checklist.why: If one closes your account, the other still pays rent.

checklist.label: A backup way to take a card
checklist.why: A processor drop should cost you a week, not a season.

checklist.label: One lean month in cash or a place nobody can freeze
checklist.why: A frozen account is a frozen life without it.

checklist.label: The practice's money apart from your own
checklist.why: Records stay clean and a closure hits one, not both.

checklist.label: Nothing large left sitting on a platform
checklist.why: Take payouts on a schedule. A held balance is a loan you did not agree to.
